# Artwork

Artwork supplied by the repository owner for the launcher and Steam integration.
Game artwork and trademarks belong to their respective owners; the source code license
is not a grant of rights to these images. No game executable or game data is included.

- `app-icon.png`: owner-selected desktop application icon.
- `ic_home_dark.png`, `ic_home_light.png`: launcher logo selected by the active theme.
- `ic_grid.png`: Steam portrait cover.
- `ic_heroes.png`: Steam library hero banner.
- `ic_logo.png`: Steam library logo.
- `ic_app.png`, `logo.png`: additional owner-supplied artwork retained for future use.

Add to Steam installs artwork for the shortcut ID and preserves an existing image
as a `.png.bak` file before replacing it. Steam must be closed when adding a shortcut.
